main.remarks: An immutable policy snapshot supplied to access-manager policy evaluators during request, issuance, authorization, and revocation flows.

property.name: AccessKeyRealmID
property.summary: Current access-key realm identifier for the evaluation.

property.name: Claims
property.summary: Decrypted access-key claims when the flow already has a token claims view; otherwise null.

property.name: AssertionSummaries
property.summary: Lightweight assertion summaries available to the policy evaluation flow; otherwise null.

property.name: Expired
property.summary: True when the validated key was expired at the evaluation instant.

property.name: EvaluatedAt
property.summary: UTC instant when the policy context was assembled.

property.name: IssueOptions
property.summary: Requested issuance options for issuance flows; otherwise null.

property.name: Logger
property.summary: Optional logger made available to policy engines and stages for evaluation-time diagnostics.

property.name: Key
property.summary: Access key under evaluation for access and revocation flows; otherwise null.

property.name: ManifestHash
property.summary: Current manifest hash for the evaluation.

property.name: ManifestMatched
property.summary: True when the validated key matches the current tool schema, realm, and manifest hash.

property.name: MembershipActive
property.summary: True when the validated key is still present in the active membership set.

property.name: Mode
property.summary: Access-management workflow currently being evaluated.

property.name: Operation
property.summary: Protected operation index under evaluation for access flows; otherwise null.

property.name: OperationAllowed
property.summary: True when the validated key allows the requested protected operation.

property.name: Operations
property.summary: Requested protected-operation set for issuance flows; otherwise null.

property.name: RequestContext
property.summary: Normalized request-specific policy facts for request evaluation flows; otherwise null.

property.name: SignatureValidation
property.summary: Signature parsing and verification facts supplied by the owning access manager for token-based flows.

property.name: Subject
property.summary: Subject for the evaluation. For token-based flows this comes from the decrypted claims.

property.name: Tool
property.summary: Owning tool associated with the access manager.

property.name: ToolSchemaID
property.summary: Current tool schema identifier for the evaluation.
